rationale: KAN-257 delta-review P1: the route-sync CI step (ci.yml 'Generate OpenAPI snapshot & verify Rust↔Python route sync') failed at 6fc2778 because the 3 KAN-208/211 v2 routes were never added to route_kind() in rust_core/src/server.rs; it was masked on main because the pytest step aborted the job before route-sync ran.
